Owner concern: keep the prepared permission request unsent unless human counsel reviews it and the owner explicitly authorizes outreach.
Preserve the existing workstreams only; do not create duplicate requests or queue new implementation work.
Keep aggregate commission unattributed and continue reconciliation of conflicting cost records before any financial claim or spend decision.

Keep the gated product private and continue the existing read-only launch checklist. No public exposure, deployment, configuration change, credential change, alert expansion, monetization expansion, or external outreach is authorized.
Continue bounded read-only security evidence capture and failed-work containment. Do not requeue, deploy, add dependencies, retrieve credentials, change permissions, or expand public exposure.
